subject: Arcadia Financial - compliance & retention sprint plan
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@arcadia-fin.com>, Meera Shah <meera.shah@arcadia-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: Arcadia Financial - compliance & retention sprint plan

Thanks for your time today — appreciate the clear framing of the risk and acceptance criteria. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Primary ask: strict audit log retention and exportability for regulatory review (7+ years retention for transaction metadata).
- Pen test evidence: Arcadia needs public-facing pen test report and remediation timeline (vendor + host infra split).
- DPA / contractual: want DPA with explicit data residency/transfer clauses and SLA for data exports (48h request window).
- SOC 2: request for our SOC 2 summary, control mapping for audit scope, and any persistent exceptions.

What Redwood will provide (first pass)
- SOC 2 snapshot (summary + control owners) — attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
- Audit log retention matrix showing where logs live, export formats, and TTL config — attachment: auditlog-retention-matrix.xlsx
- Pen test summary (redacted) and statement of scope — attachment: pen-test-summary-2027.pdf

Proposed timeline & owners
- By EOD Wed (01/18): upload SOC2 snapshot + retention matrix to shared Drive (Naomi).
- By Fri (01/21): internal review of pen test artifacts and redaction plan (Marissa).
- Week of 01/24: 30-min follow-up to confirm DPA language and export SLA; suggest 01/25 10:00 EST (all).

Questions for you
1) Can you confirm the logs you need exported (transaction-level vs aggregated)?
2) Which legal contacts should we route the DPA draft to?
3) Are there any additional third-party attestations required beyond SOC2/pen test?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), auditlog-retention-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), pen-test-summary-2027.pdf (pdf)

Thanks again — looping in Marissa and Ben to own pen test redaction and retention config tasks.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-9123
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@arcadia-fin.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Meera Shah <meera.shah@arcadia-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jan 2028 18:43:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Arcadia Financial - compliance & retention sprint plan

Naomi — thanks for the concise summary. Couple clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: we need transaction-level audit events (api call, user id hashed, request id, timestamp, model id) retained for 7 years in immutable storage. Exports should be consumable as newline-delimited JSON or compressed CSV.
- Pen test: we can accept redacted reports but need a signed attestation from the 3rd-party vendor about scope and findings.
- DPA: please route draft to our legal: legal@arcadia-fin.com. Note: data residency for EU customers may be required; we will flag specific accounts in the follow-up.

Also: one more ask — any SLA you can commit to for completing an ad-hoc export request? 48 hours would be ideal but we understand constraints.

Can you also include a high-level diagram of how logs traverse from container -> object storage -> archival? That will help our auditors.

Thanks — Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Information Security
Arcadia Financial
daniel.park@arcadia-fin.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@arcadia-fin.com>, Meera Shah <meera.shah@arcadia-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jan 2028 09:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Arcadia Financial - compliance & retention sprint plan

On Tue, Jan 17, 2028 at 6:43 PM Daniel Park <daniel.park@arcadia-fin.com> wrote:
> Naomi — thanks for the concise summary. Couple clarifications from our side: 
> 
> - Retention: we need transaction-level audit events (api call, user id hashed, request id, timestamp, model id) retained for 7 years in immutable storage. Exports should be consumable as newline-delimited JSON or compressed CSV.
> - Pen test: we can accept redacted reports but need a signed attestation from the 3rd-party vendor about scope and findings.
> - DPA: please route draft to our legal: legal@arcadia-fin.com. Note: data residency for EU customers may be required; we will flag specific accounts in the follow-up.

Thanks — that all makes sense. Quick replies and what we'll attach to the Drive folder: 

1) Export format: we support newline-delimited JSON exports natively; we will include a sample export schema and a short script to transform to CSV if needed. (See drive link).
2) Immutable retention: we currently support object-lock-backed buckets for legal hold and long-term retention — Ben will outline the config and TTL.
3) Pen test attestation: Marissa will reach out to our vendor to request the signed scope attestation; if vendor policy prevents full signing we will provide notarized redaction logs.
4) SLA for ad-hoc exports: baseline SLA is 5 business days; we can commit to 48-72 hours for premium customers or via dedicated capacity contract. We'll include the SLA language for review.

Proposed next steps (updated)
- 01/18 EOD: Drive folder updated with sample export schema, retention diagram, and SOC2 snapshot (Naomi).
- 01/20: Marissa to request pen test attestation and share expected delivery date.
- 01/24 or 01/25: 30-min follow-up to confirm DPA changes and export SLA. Naomi to propose times.

Drive (will upload by EOD): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cARC-Compliance
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/ARC-2028

Thanks — looping Ben for the immutable retention diagram and TTL specifics.

Best,
Naomi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Thanks Daniel — I'm on the pen test attestation request and will escalate to the vendor today. Quick notes from our side: 

- Pen test: vendor has confirmed they can provide a signed letter of attestation covering scope and findings; full raw test data will be redacted but we will include a redaction log. ETA: 01/20-01/22.
- Retention diagram: Ben attached a brief conceptual diagram in the Drive (object storage -> immutable archive -> export API).
- DPA draft: Naomi, I've prepared a starter DPA with the export SLA language; I'll send a DocuSign link for Arcadia legal to review.

Action items for Arcadia
- Please confirm (a) whether the JSON schema sample meets your auditor's needs and (b) which EU accounts you want flagged for residency controls.

I'll push the vendor attestation request now and update the Drive when complete.

Regards,
